rationale: Changed v2 entity_id handling from string to bytes with UTF-8 encoding/decoding. In process_entity(), decode v2 bytes to string for observation output while keeping v1 as string. In main block, encode 'py_101' to UTF-8 bytes when constructing v2 Entity. Both changes preserve the observation key 'entity_id' with string value and maintain v1 behavior unchanged.
assumptions: Generated protobuf bindings for v2 now expect bytes for entity_id field
Valid UTF-8 round-trip is guaranteed by the test cases
Observation output must remain a JSON string value for entity_id
The standalone sample identifier 'py_101' is valid UTF-8

candidate_reviews.reason: Line accesses entity.entity_id directly for observation output. For v2 this is now bytes and must be UTF-8 decoded to string; for v1 it remains string. Edit wraps this in version-conditional decode.

Line constructs Entity with entity_id="py_101" string literal. For v2 the field is now bytes, so the literal must be UTF-8 encoded. Edit makes construction version-conditional with explicit encode for v2.
